name: KIC 9277252
description: A red-clump giant burning helium in its core in the Kepler field, 10.6 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 9277252 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 10.5579 +/- 0.196

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 9277252 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 0.8795 +/- 0.0362

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 9277252 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4770.757 +/- 54.5736

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 9277252 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.3379 +/- 0.0045

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red-clump giant in the Kepler field, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 0.88 solar masses and 10.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,771 K at its surface.
